title: 第23章 鬼市，寻兵
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
丁字号牢房内，火光昏暗。

    江梦璃绝美的脸庞上写满了嫌弃，身体死死贴着墙壁，仿佛陈然是一个什么妖怪。

    “你到底修炼了什么鬼东西？”

    陈然端着食盒，非但没有后退，反而向前走了一步。

    “江姑娘，这可是堂堂正正的浩然之气，专克邪魔歪道。”

    他嘴角勾起一抹弧度，语气轻松，“我看你最近火气挺大，不如我多靠近点，帮你去去火？”

    “滚！”

    江梦璃气急败坏，猛地一挥衣袖。

    一股劲风袭来。

    那股带着魔教特有魅惑与阴寒的劲风，在触碰到陈然体表的瞬间，如同泥牛入海，消弭于无形。

    江梦璃瞳孔微缩，眼中闪过一丝震惊。

    她虽然被符咒锁链封印了修为，但刚才那一挥，也绝非普通狱卒能轻易化解的。

    这小子，几天不见，实力又精进了？

    而且他身上那股恶心的气息，竟然能完美克制自己的红莲魔功。

    “饭放这了，趁热吃。”

    陈然见好就收，将食盒放下，转身离开。

    听着江梦璃在身后气呼呼地咬牙切齿，陈然心情大好。

    这《浩然静心诀》果然是极品辅助功法，完美压制了暴戾之气，连带着对于精神攻击也有减免作用。

    只是，功法的问题解决了，兵器的问题却依然棘手。

    以他现在的实力，狱卒的制式长刀已经承载不起他的力量了，

    ……

    狱卒休息室。

    几个刚换班的狱卒正聚在一起吹牛打屁。

    咔哒，房门推动。

    见到来人模样，几个狱卒顿时神色恭敬。

    “陈哥。”

    “坐，我就是来看看。”陈然笑着走了过去。

    陈然身份不同于往日，虽然现在还是狱卒，但也算是个精英狱卒了。

    能负责监管丙字号牢房，又能带几个巡逻队，跟小队长职业差不多。

    张文急忙站了起来：“陈哥，我可想死你了。”

    “我就是找你问问话。”

    听闻此言，其余几名狱卒用艳羡的眼光看了一眼，识趣地退了出去。

    他们都知道曾经张文是老前辈，带领过刚入职的陈然，现在身份调转，相处的态度自然也变了。

    张文有点紧张，不知道自己哪里能帮上。

    “咋了，陈哥？”

    “想弄把防身的兵刃。”陈然压低声音，“这外头铁匠铺的刀剑，太脆了，不经用。张哥你路子广，知道哪里能弄到好货色吗？”

    张文是这里的老油条了，虽然实力不咋滴，但是情报方面肯定是要高出自己很多的。

    张文四下看了一眼，凑近陈然耳边。

    “普通铁匠铺当然只有凡铁。你想要好东西，得去鬼市。”
content_en:
In the T-shaped cell, the fire was dim.

    Jiang Mengli's beautiful face was filled with disgust, and her body was pressed against the wall, as if Chen Ran was some kind of monster.

    "What the hell have you practiced?"

    Chen Ran was holding the food box, but instead of retreating, he took a step forward.

    "Miss Jiang, this is an upright and awe-inspiring aura, designed to defeat the evil ways."

    The corner of his mouth curled up, and his tone was relaxed, "I think you've been very angry recently, why don't you let me get closer and help you calm down the anger?"

    "Get out!"

    Jiang Mengli was furious and suddenly waved her sleeves.

    A strong wind came.

    The strong wind with the unique charm and coldness of the Demon Sect, the moment it touched Chen Ran's body, disappeared like a mud cow entering the sea.

    Jiang Mengli's pupils shrank, and a trace of shock flashed in her eyes.

    Although her cultivation was sealed by the talisman chain, the wave just now was not something that ordinary jailers could easily resolve.

    I haven’t seen this kid for a few days, but his strength has improved again?

    Moreover, the disgusting aura on his body was able to perfectly restrain his Red Lotus Demonic Skill.

    "Here is the rice. Eat it while it's hot."

    Chen Ran put it away when he saw it was good, put down the food box, turned around and left.

    Listening to Jiang Mengli gnashing her teeth angrily behind her, Chen Ran was in a good mood.

    This "Haoran Meditation Technique" is indeed the best auxiliary skill, which perfectly suppresses violent energy and also reduces mental attacks.

    However, the problem of skills has been solved, but the problem of weapons is still thorny.

    With his current strength, the jailer's standard sword can no longer bear his strength.

    …

    Jailer's Lounge.

    Several guards who had just finished their shift were getting together to brag and spank.

    Click, the door opens.

    Seeing the appearance of the visitor, several jailers suddenly looked respectful.

    "Brother Chen."

    "Sit down, I just came to take a look." Chen Ran walked over with a smile.

    Chen Ran's identity is different from before. Although he is still a jailer now, he can be regarded as an elite jailer.

    He can be responsible for supervising Cell C and lead several patrol teams, which is similar to the occupation of a squad leader.

    Zhang Wen stood up in a hurry: "Brother Chen, I miss you so much."

    "I just want to ask you something."

    Hearing this, the other jailers looked at him with envy and withdrew wisely.

    They all know that Zhang Wen was once a senior who led Chen Ran, who had just joined the company. Now that his status has been changed, his attitude towards getting along with him has naturally changed.

    Zhang Wen was a little nervous and didn't know where he could help.

    "What's wrong, Brother Chen?"

    "I want to get a weapon for self-defense." Chen Ran lowered his voice, "The swords in the blacksmith shop outside are too brittle and useless. Brother Zhang, you have a wide range of ways. Do you know where to get good ones?"

    Zhang Wen is a veteran here. Although his strength is not that good, his intelligence is definitely much higher than his own.

    Zhang Wen glanced around and leaned close to Chen Ran's ear.

    "Of course ordinary blacksmith shops only have ordinary iron. If you want good stuff, you have to go to the ghost market."
title_en: Chapter 23 Ghost Market, Looking for Soldiers
